ok so here's how we get to building a 100M company in two weeks before thanksgiving.. 

first, our preseed plan. we're going to raise $2M. why $2M? simple. $200k for the launch video, $200k to promote the launch video to xM impressions - i have six agencies lined up for this don't sweat with no paid partnerships tag duhh, and $500k for the tokens i'm going to obliterate to have a resemblance of a product. again its all token spend and no employee spend because vcs dont want that. solo founders is hot again so i can fully get away with this lfg.

ok, so next we use the token spend that i can vibe code and sell to "wink friendly wink" customers and have them give me LOIs and cARR - in return for using their products obviously. scratch mine, scratch yours. ok then i can fully wrap in the most creative financial metrics possible to show xM in revenue of ARR because who even knows what that means anymore. 

and then i'm going to run the tighteeest possible process as possible for my "already oversubscribed seed". get some sick angels at a discount duhh, fomo VCs, get that tier 1 TS, shop it, and tranche it to the moon baby. first at 40M, then 80M and then finally a few angels at $100M. 

of course i'm going to incorporate the company as late as possible even though all the machinery is there. so i can claim 0->10M in revenue on day 14 or whatever. 

and yeah completely forgot that i need a sick vision and a full deck, that will need $100k for someone to drill that to me cause i ain't got no clue what this category even means. don't sweat, there's a fundraising expert who might take x% and some cash or whatever to help me whisper to the right networks. yeah, that's a thing. 

diligence? who needs charts and due diligence, we live in the token economy, and lfg economy baby. elections and the market selloff? don't sweat, the seed market is still red hot, it might take a day more, but this will still most def work.

anyway, i'm going to go try this and i'll see you in two weeks eh?

(before i get obliterated this is satire, but every sentence in there individually has personally happened to me)
